visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a man with short black hair wearing a dark blue button-up shirt. He stands in front of a red wall adorned with a bright blue and pink neon sign that reads "TAIWAN BAR." On the shelves behind him, various glass liquor bottles are arranged neatly. He gestures confidently toward the camera. (2) The man continues to speak, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize his points. A small cartoon avatar of a female figure appears in the lower-left corner. An archival photo of an old television show, featuring a man and woman on stage, is inserted as a floating frame next to him. (3) The visual shifts to archival, standard-definition footage of a dating show set. Two hosts are visible on a stage with heart-shaped decorations. Overlaid text provides historical context. (4) Back in the bar studio, the man gestures toward another archival image showing the hosts of a different variety show. He uses his hands to mimic the flow of his narrative. (5) The screen displays a montage of clips from older television programs, showing participants meeting and graphics highlighting successful couples. (6) The man returns to center frame, explaining modern changes. A screen-recording overlay appears, showing a close-up of a hand scrolling through a smartphone interface against a white background. (7) Visuals change to high-definition promotional clips and posters from a modern Korean dating show, featuring young people on a tropical beach. (8) In the final phase, the man looks directly into the camera with a playful and confident smile, pointing his thumb toward himself as the video ends.

[Subtitle]: 我愛紅娘 從1982年開播. (5) [Subtitle]: 播了大概11年 非常非常久. (6) [Subtitle]: 而且這段期間促成了 700 多對的佳偶. (7) [Variety]: 這麼多. (8) [Subtitle]: 到了90年代 有另外一個節目 非常長青 非常男女 我小時候都看過. (9) [Subtitle]: 該不會還參加過. [Subtitle]: 我? 我需要嗎.
